title: Too High a Price
question: What does the writer describe as an 'amusing old-fashioned source of noise' ?

meanings.usage: 指对环境的损害，如空气、水、噪音污染
描述工业发展过度的状态
表示数量或力量大到无法处理
用于消灭害虫的化学物质

meanings.meaning: 阴险的，狡诈的；暗中为害的
meanings.usage: 形容危险或问题不易察觉但逐渐扩散
与城市相关的，反义词为rural（农村的）
强调动作或状态的持续性
做错事或违反规则的人
放弃某种习惯、信仰或地方
形容数量或程度令人难以置信
指位于头顶上方的东西

phrases.phrase: when you come to think about it
phrases.usage: 固定表达，意思是'当你仔细想想'，用于引出思考后的结论

examples.en: When you come to think about it, there are only four ways to deal with rubbish.
examples.zh: 当你仔细想想，垃圾处理只有四种方式。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，表示'导致'，后接结果或后果

examples.en: The need to produce cheap food leads to a different kind of pollution.
examples.zh: 生产廉价食品的需求导致了另一种污染。

phrases.phrase: at any time of the day or night
phrases.usage: 固定短语，意思是'无论白天还是黑夜'，强调随时都可能发生

examples.en: Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night annoy passers-by.
examples.zh: 无论白天还是黑夜响起防盗警报都会惹恼路人。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，表示'对...做出贡献'，to为介词

examples.en: New technology has made its own contribution to noise.
examples.zh: 新技术也对噪音做出了'贡献'。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，表示'在从...到...的范围内'，用于描述测量范围

examples.en: Noise pollution was rated on a scale ranging from 1 to 7.
examples.zh: 噪音污染按1到7的等级进行评分。

phrases.usage: 短语，表示'长期大量的某物'，常指频繁接触某事物

examples.en: You may have a steady diet of pesticides every time you eat vegetables.
examples.zh: 每次吃蔬菜时你可能都在大量摄入农药。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，表示'继续做某事'，强调动作的持续性

examples.en: We keep trying all four methods, but the volume threatens to overwhelm us.
examples.zh: 我们不断尝试这四种方法，但垃圾量之大让我们难以应对。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，表示'似乎，看来'，用于表达推测

examples.en: Silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.
examples.zh: 看来，静谧已经成为了一段黄金记忆。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，表示'有...的选择'，后面接选择的内容

examples.en: You have the choice of very expensive organically-grown vegetables.
examples.zh: 你可以选择非常昂贵的有机蔬菜。

phrases.usage: think + that从句的用法，表示'认为你会放弃'

examples.en: And if you think you'll abandon meat and become a vegetarian...
examples.zh: 如果你认为自己会放弃肉类成为素食者...

sentences.en: Pollution is the price we pay for an overpopulated, overindustrialized planet.
sentences.zh: 污染是人口过剩、过度工业化的地球所付出的代价。

sentences.en: When you come to think about it, there are only four ways you can deal with rubbish:
sentences.zh: 仔细想想，处理垃圾只有四种方法：

sentences.en: dump it, burn it, turn it into something you can use again, attempt to produce less of it.
sentences.zh: 倾倒、焚烧、回收利用，或者试图减少垃圾产量。

sentences.en: We keep trying all four methods, but the sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在尝试这四种方法，但全球垃圾的巨大产量正威胁着要将我们淹没。

sentences.en: Rubbish, however, is only part of the problem of polluting our planet.
sentences.zh: 然而，垃圾只是污染地球问题的一部分。

sentences.en: The need to produce ever increasing quantities of cheap food leads to a different kind of pollution.
sentences.zh: 生产日益增长的廉价食物的需求导致了另一种污染。

sentences.en: Industrialized farming methods produce cheap meat products: beef, pork and chicken.
sentences.zh: 工业化农业方法生产廉价肉类产品：牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉。

sentences.en: The use of pesticides and fertilizers produces cheap grain and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 杀虫剂和化肥的使用生产廉价谷物和蔬菜。

sentences.en: The price we pay for cheap food may be already too high:
sentences.zh: 我们为廉价食物付出的代价可能已经太高了：

sentences.en: Mad Cow Disease (BSE) in cattle, salmonella in chicken and eggs, and listeria in dairy products.
sentences.zh: 牛身上的疯牛病（BSE），鸡肉和鸡蛋中的沙门氏菌，以及奶制品中的李斯特菌。

sentences.en: And if you think you'll abandon meat and become a vegetarian,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为你会放弃肉类成为素食者，

sentences.en: you have the choice of very expensive organically-grown vegetables
sentences.zh: 你可以选择非常昂贵的有机蔬菜，

sentences.en: or a steady diet of pesticides every time you think you're eating fresh salads and vegetables,
sentences.zh: 或者每次你以为在吃新鲜沙拉和蔬菜时，都伴随着大量的农药，

sentences.en: or just having an innocent glass of water!
sentences.zh: 或者仅仅是喝一杯纯净的水！

sentences.en: However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban area and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
sentences.zh: 然而，还有一种更阴险的污染，它尤其影响城市地区并侵入我们的日常生活，那就是噪音。

sentences.en: Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night serve only to annoy passers-by and actually assist burglars to burgle.
sentences.zh: 昼夜不停响起的防盗警报只会惹恼路人，并实际上帮助窃贼入室盗窃。

sentences.en: Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street and are a source of profound irritation.
sentences.zh: 汽车警报在街上不断对我们尖叫，是极度恼人的来源。

sentences.en: A recent survey of the effects of noise revealed (surprisingly?)
sentences.zh: 最近一项关于噪音影响的调查显示（令人惊讶的是？）

sentences.en: that dogs barking incessantly in the night rated the highest form of noise pollution on a scale ranging from 1 to 7.
sentences.zh: 狗在夜间不停吠叫被评为1到7级噪音污染中最高的形式。

sentences.en: The survey revealed a large number of sources of noise that we really dislike.
sentences.zh: 该调查揭示了许多我们真正不喜欢的噪音来源。

sentences.en: Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks,
sentences.zh: 夏日里割草机的嗡嗡声，公寓楼里的深夜派对，

sentences.en: noisy neighbours, vehicles of all kinds,
sentences.zh: 吵闹的邻居，各种车辆，

sentences.en: especially large container trucks thundering through quiet villages,
sentences.zh: 特别是大型集装箱卡车轰隆隆地穿过宁静的村庄，

sentences.en: planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
sentences.zh: 飞机和直升机从头顶飞过，公共场所里大声播放的收音机。

sentences.en: New technology has also made its own contribution to noise.
sentences.zh: 新技术也对噪音有所“贡献”。

sentences.en: A lot of people object to mobile phones, especially when they are used in public places like restaurants or on public transport.
sentences.zh: 很多人反对手机，尤其是在餐馆或公共交通工具等公共场所使用手机。

sentences.en: Loud conversations on mobile phones invade our thoughts or interrupt the pleasure of meeting friends for a quiet chat.
sentences.zh: 手机上的大声对话侵扰我们的思绪，或者打断我们与朋友安静聊天的乐趣。

sentences.en: The noise pollution survey revealed a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.
sentences.zh: 噪音污染调查揭示了一个相当令人惊讶且可能有趣的、老式的噪音来源。

sentences.en: It turned out to be snoring! Men were found to be the worst offenders.
sentences.zh: 结果是打鼾！男性被发现是最大的“罪魁祸首”。

sentences.en: It was revealed that 20% of men in their mid-thirties snore.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，20%的三十多岁男性会打鼾。

sentences.en: This figure rises to a staggering 60% of men in their sixties.
sentences.zh: 这个数字在六十多岁男性中飙升至惊人的60%。

sentences.en: Against these figures, it was found that only 5% of women snore regularly,
sentences.zh: 与这些数字相比，只有5%的女性会规律性打鼾，

sentences.en: while the rest are constantly woken or kept awake by their trumpeting partners.
sentences.zh: 而其余的女性则不断地被她们打鼾的伴侣吵醒或保持清醒。

sentences.en: Whatever the source of noise, one thing is certain: silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.
sentences.zh: 无论噪音来源是什么，有一件事是肯定的：宁静，似乎已成为一段美好的回忆。

exercises.explain: profound · /prəˈfaʊnd/ · adjective · 深刻的，极度的。程度很深，强烈的

source.en: The noise pollution survey revealed a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.

grammar.title: 定语从句（使用that/which/who）
grammar.definition: 定语从句用于修饰名词或代词，由关系代词（that, which, who, whom）或关系副词（where, when, why）引导，置于被修饰词之后。
grammar.structure: 主句 + 名词/代词 + 关系词 + 定语从句
grammar.usage: 用于提供关于名词的额外信息，使句子更加完整和精确。在本课中，多处使用了that/which引导的定语从句。

examples.en: The survey that/which revealed these findings was conducted recently.
examples.zh: 揭示这些发现的调查是最近进行的。

examples.en: Dogs barking incessantly in the night was rated as the highest form of noise pollution.
examples.zh: 夜间不断吠叫的狗被评为最高形式的噪音污染。

examples.en: New technology that has made its own contribution to noise is a concern.
examples.zh: 对噪音做出'贡献'的新技术令人担忧。

grammar.title: 副词的位置和作用
grammar.definition: 副词在句中可以位于句首、句中或句尾，用来修饰动词、形容词或其他副词，表示时间、方式、程度、频率等。
grammar.structure: 副词 + 动词 / 动词 + 副词 / 主语 + 副词 + 动词
grammar.usage: 在本课中，insidiously, constantly, incessantly等副词描述了污染的持续性和隐藏性特点，帮助读者理解问题的严重程度。

examples.en: There is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban areas.
examples.zh: 有一种更为隐蔽的污染，特别影响城市地区。

examples.en: Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street.
examples.zh: 汽车警报在街上不断对我们尖叫。

examples.en: Dogs barking incessantly in the night rated the highest form of noise pollution.
examples.zh: 夜间持续吠叫的狗被评为最高形式的噪音污染。

grammar.title: 百分数表达在描述数据中的应用
grammar.definition: 使用百分数（percent/percentage）来描述统计数据，是学术和新闻写作中的常见表达方式。
grammar.structure: 数字 + % + of + 名词 + 谓语
grammar.usage: 在描述调查结果、人口数据或比例时使用。本课中多处使用百分比来说明打鼾问题的普遍性。

examples.en: 20% of men in their mid-thirties snore.
examples.zh: 处于三十五岁左右的男人中有20%打鼾。

examples.en: This figure rises to a staggering 60% of men in their sixties.
examples.zh: 这个数字攀升到六十岁男人的惊人60%。

examples.en: Only 5% of women snore regularly.
examples.zh: 只有5%的女性经常打鼾。

original.en: Pollution is the price we pay for an overpopulated, overindustrialized planet.
original.zh: 污染是我们为这个人口过剩、工业过度发展的星球所付出的代价。

examples.en: Traffic jams are the price we pay for modernization.
examples.zh: 交通拥堵是我们为现代化付出的代价。

examples.en: Stress is the price we pay for a competitive society.
examples.zh: 压力是我们为竞争社会付出的代价。

patterns.pattern: There are only + 数字 + ways you can...

original.en: There are only four ways you can deal with rubbish.
original.zh: 处理垃圾只有四种方式。

examples.en: There are only three ways you can solve this problem.
examples.zh: 解决这个问题只有三种方法。

examples.en: There are only two choices you can make now.
examples.zh: 你现在只有两个选择。

patterns.pattern: The price we pay for...may be already too high

original.en: The price we pay for cheap food may be already too high.
original.zh: 我们为廉价食品付出的代价可能已经太高了。

examples.en: The price we pay for convenience may be already too high.
examples.zh: 我们为便利付出的代价可能已经太高了。

examples.en: The price we pay for fast delivery may be already too high.
examples.zh: 我们为快递付出的代价可能已经太高了。

patterns.pattern: It turned out to be + 名词/动名词

original.en: It turned out to be snoring!

examples.en: The mysterious noise turned out to be a cat.
examples.zh: 那个神秘的噪音原来是一只猫。

examples.en: The solution turned out to be much simpler than expected.
examples.zh: 解决办法原来比预期的简单得多。
